title: Accept DXF LAYER control without an extension dictionary

source.repositoryStatus: test source creates ASCII/Binary control in the build scratch directory; no drawing fixture was added
source.profile: AC1027 DXF with one LAYER TABLE control handle and a layer row, without an extension dictionary

finding.failure: A valid absent xdictionary handle is represented as 0, the same value as DRW::NoHandle. The DXF layer-control callback rejected 0 as invalid, and the getter repeated that rejection before its intended no-dictionary success branch.
finding.correction: Treat dictionary handle 0 as absence when a valid nonzero table control handle is present. Keep rejecting a missing control handle and a nonzero dictionary with no owner control.
finding.scope: This admits the no-extension-dictionary case only. It does not qualify an LAYER control extension graph or alter DWG layer-control source publication.

build.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target dwg2dxf libdxfrw_block_owner_tests libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests -j4

physicalDwg.result: Strict refusal remains at source XRECORD 0x121F group 1071, after extension-graph admission and INSERT target resolution.

planImpact.remainingP4Scope: No change to the P4 exit gate. Physical DWG output remains blocked at XRECORD 0x121F group 1071; the Title_Block-ARCH complete graph and staged-byte/fresh-readback proof remain open.
